# L11: Fill-in-the-blank hook templates: Expertise, Warning, Desire, Promise (+ Challenge, Ranking, List)

Adam Kelada (@adam.kelada.media) · ig-reel · https://www.instagram.com/p/DeJ8N6lIaLm/ · notes: [lessons/11_viral-hook-templates.md](../../brain/lessons/11_viral-hook-templates.md)

**Core lesson:** Seven hook templates with blanks, each followed by a real viral reel that used it and its view count. New to the Brain: Expertise ('3 years of [niche] in 60 seconds'), Warning ('Never start a [X] if you don't have these [Y] things'), Desire ('This is exactly what you want to see when you're [X]') and Promise ('If you take [B] every single day you're going to [X], [Y] and [Z]'); plus a template-bank hook method and a template-then-example teaching format.


## Ideas from this source (11)

- **[Expertise hook: years of niche in 60 seconds](../topics/hooks.md#l11-expertise-hook)** · hooks: Template: "[N years] of [niche] in [60 seconds]". A big time investment, the topic and a tiny time cost in one line: authority without saying 'I'm an expert', plus a compression promise (my years, your minute). Context and lean land together. Reel's example: "3 years of therapy in 60 seconds" (on-screen '3 years of Therapy in 1 minute', pill 40.5M).
- **[Warning hook: never start X without these N things](../topics/hooks.md#l11-warning-hook)** · hooks: Template: "Never start a [X] if you don't have these [Y] things". A prohibition on a big action the viewer is considering, gated by a counted checklist. Loss aversion plus an open loop (which things? do I have them?); unlike a pure 'don't buy X' debunk it ends with something useful. Reel's example: "Never start a business if you don't have these 4 things" (number tiles 1-2-3-4, red '4 THINGS', pill 339K).
- **[Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see](../topics/hooks.md#l11-desire-hook)** · hooks: Template: "This is exactly what you want to see when you're [situation]". 'This' points at a visual of the ideal outcome; the situation lets the right viewer self-select. The spoken context arrives at the end of the sentence, so the visual must carry it from frame 1. Reel's example: "This is exactly what you want to see when you're buying an industrial prop[erty]" over an aerial warehouse shot with a map pin (pill 3.6M).
- **[Promise hook: daily habit, three payoffs](../topics/hooks.md#l11-promise-hook)** · hooks: Template: "If you [do B] every single day, you're going to [X], [Y] and [Z]". A tiny repeatable habit, 'every single day', then three concrete outcomes (rule of three). Each outcome is another reason to care. Reel's example: "If you take creatine every single day, you're going to build more muscle, recover faster, and get way more out of all the hard work that you're putting in in the gym" (pill 28M, the reel's biggest example).
- **[Hook template bank (fill in the blanks)](../topics/hooks.md#l11-hook-template-bank)** · hooks: Hooks as reusable fill-in templates with blanks ([X], [Y], [niche]) harvested from proven viral reels, each kept with its proof (the example reel and its views). Pick a template, fill the blanks for your niche. A third hook method next to the engineered triple hook (L01) and 'say something crazy' (L08). Adam sells the full bank as a lead magnet: '100+ Proven Viral Hook Templates'.
- **[Challenge, ranking and list templates](../topics/hooks.md#l11-classic-hook-templates)** · hooks: The three classic templates spelled out: Challenge "I'm going to [X] for [Y] days straight" (example: study 8 hours, 5 days straight, 4.9M); Ranking "Rating [X] so you don't waste your [Y]" (example: rating supplements so you don't waste your money, S–F tier board, 4.7M); List "These are the 5 best ways to use [X]" (example: sound effects, 1.9M). Each carries a hard number or names what the viewer saves.
- **[Teaching format: template card, then a real example](../topics/editing.md#l11-template-then-example)** · editing: Each item = a template card (~2–3 s: numbered badge, the template typing on with blanks in yellow) followed by a real viral reel that used it (~2–3.5 s, full-frame with its own audio and a view-count pill). 7 pairs in 49.6 s; 48% of the runtime is other creators' clips.
- **[View-count pill on every example](../topics/effects.md#l11-view-count-proof-pill)** · effects: A dark rounded pill with an eye icon and the example's views (40.5M, 339K, 4.9M, 4.7M, 1.9M, 3.6M, 28M) sits lower-centre on every borrowed clip, so each claim arrives with proof. The numbers are the creator's overlay, not verified.
- **[Template card type: badge + hand-lettered text, yellow blanks](../topics/text.md#l11-template-card-typography)** · text: A dark translucent pill badge (yellow ring number + condensed sans label, e.g. '1 Expertise Hook') with a thin rule under it, then the template typing on word by word in a casual hand-lettered font with a white glow; blanks [X] [Y] [niche] in yellow-orange with glow. Centred at ~64% height on his chest.
- **[Visual table of contents in the first 2 s](../topics/hooks.md#l11-toc-intro)** · hooks: 0–2 s: a blur-in and a 30% eased punch-out while a frosted-glass numbered list of all 7 hook names scrolls up above his head and '7HOOK' (heavy rounded red neon sans + white script 'that'll always work') sits on his chest. The viewer sees the whole menu (and the count) before the first item.
- **[Lead-magnet CTA over a recap strip](../topics/growth.md#l11-lead-magnet-recap-cta)** · growth: CTA: "If you want a list of 100 proven viral hooks just like these, comment the word hook and I'll send them to you for free", over a sideways-scrolling strip of every example clip, '100 PROVEN VIRAL HOOKS' and a glowing yellow 'HOOK'. Caption: '(No emails)'. Result at download: 5,564 comments on 8,070 likes.
